about_the_game:
Unleash your creativity! These decorative effects will inspire you to craft outstanding videos.

This set includes:
  • Brush and Paint Pack
  • Threads and Needles Pack
  • Theater Pack
  • Funky Vibes Pack
  • In this set, you’ll find:

  • 34 titles
  • 27 stickers
  • 14 backgrounds
  • 13 transitions
  • 3 intros

The DLC set is compatible with Movavi Video Editor Plus 2022.
